# `negated-comptime-expression`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports `!comptime expression`, whose precedence is easy to misread.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Hoisting negation inside the comptime expression makes both evaluation timing
and boolean grouping explicit.

## When it fires

It applies to direct negation adjacent to `comptime`; the suggested form
preserves the intended expression.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn skip() void {
    if (!comptime builtin.isDebug()) return;
}
```
